Right axilla, core biopsy:
- FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA.

Sections show an atypical nodular lymphoid proliferation with closely packed follicles composed predominantly of centrocytes and scattered centroblasts. The mantle zones are attenuated.

Immunohistochemistry shows the atypical lymphoid cells are positive for CD20, PAX5, CD19, CD10, BCL6, and BCL2. They are negative for cyclin D1, CD5, CD43, and LEF1. Ki-67 is approximately 20%. CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks. CD3 and CD5 highlight background T cells.

COMMENT
The morphologic and immunophenotypic findings support follicular lymphoma.
